name: Work Reassignment Created
description: Sent to the user whose work is being reassigned and the user receiving the work when a new work reassignment configuration is created.
subject: Nouvelle réaffectation automatique pour ${reassignedFromName}
body:
Nouvelle réaffectation automatique

Bonjour $__recipient.name,

#set($_startDate = $__dateTool.toDate("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss", ${startDate})) #set($_formattedStartDate = $__dateTool.format("EEEEE, MMMMM dd, YYYY", $_startDate)) #set($_endDate = $__dateTool.toDate("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss", ${endDate})) #set($_formattedEndDate = $__dateTool.format("EEEEE, MMMMM dd, YYYY", $_endDate))

${modifiedByName} a configuré la réaffectation automatique de ${configType} de ${reassignedFromName} vers ${reassignedToName}, à compter du ${_formattedStartDate} #if( ${endDate} != "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z") et jusqu'au ${_formattedEndDate}. #{else} sans date de fin. #end

Cordialement,
L'équipe $__global.productName
